_comment: Proposed answers for the OpenSSF Best Practices badge, derived from evidence in this repository. Only criteria backed by a file or setting are listed; everything else is left for the maintainers to answer. Format: https://github.com/ossf/best-practices-badge/blob/main/docs/bestpractices-json.md
dependency_monitoring_justification: Composer Audit checks the dependencies against known vulnerabilities in CI and fails the job on any advisory it finds, so a vulnerable dependency has to be upgraded or explicitly handled before a change passes. If the advisory source stays unreachable after three attempts, the job passes with a visible warning that no audit took place: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/blob/main/.github/workflows/checks.yml (shared workflow: https://github.com/netresearch/typo3-ci-workflows/blob/main/.github/workflows/security.yml).
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests are public, searchable, addressable by URL and need no proprietary client: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/issues
license_location_justification: The licence file is in the repository root: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/blob/main/LICENSE
repo_distributed_justification: The repository uses git, hosted at https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming
repo_public_justification: The source repository is public on GitHub: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming
repo_track_justification: Git records the author, date and change of every commit; the history is browsable at https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/commits/main
report_archive_justification: Public bug reports and the responses to them stay searchable in the issue tracker: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/issues?q=is%3Aissue
report_process_justification: Bugs are reported through the GitHub issue tracker: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/issues
sites_https_justification: Every project site is served over HTTPS: the repository, https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming.
static_analysis_justification: PHPStan runs on every pull request through https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml, which calls the shared TYPO3 CI where PHPStan is on by default (https://github.com/netresearch/typo3-ci-workflows/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml). Configuration: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/blob/main/phpstan.neon.
test_justification: The repository carries 5 PHPUnit test files under https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/tree/main/Tests (1 performance, 4 unit). CI runs the unit suite on every pull request through https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml, which calls the shared TYPO3 CI (https://github.com/netresearch/typo3-ci-workflows/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml) with its unit-test job (on by default).
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: CI runs the unit suite on every pull request through https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml, which calls the shared TYPO3 CI (https://github.com/netresearch/typo3-ci-workflows/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml) with its unit-test job (on by default).
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private reports go through GitHub private vulnerability reporting, described in https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/blob/main/SECURITY.md: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/security/advisories/new (the repository setting is enabled, as the GitHub API reports for GET /repos/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/private-vulnerability-reporting)
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: The vulnerability reporting process is published in https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-xliff-streaming/blob/main/SECURITY.md
